title: CTAB-Based RNA Extraction with Qiagen RNeasy Cleanup
author: Gonzalo Villarino
materials: Bring RNase-free gloves and sterile tools (scissors, tweezers).

steps.title: Prepare equipment and reagents
steps.instruction: Set up a portable analytical balance in the greenhouse, tare it, pre‑chill spatulas in cryogenic‑safe containers with liquid nitrogen, prepare fresh CTAB buffer (keep at 65 °C) and pre‑cool the centrifuge to 4 °C.

steps.title: Collect and weigh plant material
steps.instruction: Cut fresh flowers with sterile scissors (one sample at a time), label a 50 mL Falcon tube for each cultivar, weigh approximately 100 mg of tissue, poke holes in the Falcon tube lid, and place the weighed sample into the tube.

steps.title: Flash‑freeze and grind tissue
steps.instruction: Immediately flash‑freeze the plant material in liquid nitrogen, then grind it to a fine powder in liquid nitrogen using a mortar and pestle, keeping the sample fully frozen throughout.

steps.title: Transfer powder to extraction tube
steps.instruction: Using a chilled spatula, transfer the frozen powdered tissue into a 2 mL RNase‑free tube.

steps.title: Add CTAB buffer and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL pre‑heated CTAB buffer (65 °C) to the tube with the plant powder using a P1000 pipette, then vortex thoroughly for 1 minute.

steps.title: Incubate CTAB extraction
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube in a water bath at 65 °C for 10 minutes, mixing occasionally by inverting the tube.

steps.title: Phase separation with chloroform
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume (1 mL) of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol, vortex for 30 seconds, then incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes for optimal phase separation.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 10 minutes at 4 °C, then transfer approximately 500 µL of the clear upper aqueous phase to a fresh 1.5 mL RNase‑free tube using a P200 pipette, avoiding disturbance of the interface.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA with NaOAc and ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 3 M sodium acetate and 1 250 µL of 100 % ethanol, invert the tube 5–6 times to mix, and incubate at –20 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Pellet RNA and wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 20 minutes at 4 °C, discard the supernatant slowly without touching the pellet, wash the pellet with 1 mL of 75 % ethanol (invert 5–6 times, do NOT vortex), centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 5 minutes at 4 °C, pipette out the ethanol with a P200, air‑dry the pellet for 10 minutes at room temperature, then repeat the centrifuge and supernatant‑discard step once more.

steps.title: Dissolve RNA in Buffer RLT
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm 400 µL Buffer RLT containing β‑mercaptoethanol to 37 °C, add it to the dried pellet, pipette up and down gently until fully dissolved; if dissolution is incomplete, incubate at 37 °C for 5 minutes and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Homogenize lysate with QIAshredder
steps.instruction: Pass the lysate through a QIAshredder spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge at ≥8 000 × g for 2 minutes; transfer the cleared ~400 µL flow‑through to a new tube and discard the QIAshredder column.

steps.title: Add ethanol and bind to RNeasy column
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL ethanol (96–100 %, 0.5× volume) to the flow‑through, mix gently by pipetting, then transfer the mixture onto a pink RNeasy spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge at ≥8 000 × g for 15 seconds, discarding the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column with RW1 and RPE
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL Buffer RW1, centrifuge at ≥8 000 × g for 15 seconds and discard flow‑through; add 500 µL Buffer RPE, centrifuge 15 seconds and discard; add another 500 µL Buffer RPE, centrifuge at ≥8 000 × g for 2 minutes to remove residual ethanol.

steps.title: Final ethanol removal and elution prep
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge at full speed (≥10 000 rpm) for 1 minute, then transfer the column to a fresh 1.5 mL RNase‑free tube, add 30 µL pre‑warmed RNase‑free water (37 °C) directly onto the membrane and let it sit for 1 minute.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at ≥8 000 × g for 1 minute to elute the RNA into the tube.

steps.title: DNase treatment
steps.instruction: Prepare a DNase mix by combining 10 µL RNase‑free DNase I with 70 µL Buffer RDD and mixing gently; apply the 80 µL mix directly onto the membrane, incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes, add 350 µL Buffer RW1 to wash out the DNase, centrifuge at ≥8 000 × g for 15 seconds and discard the flow‑through.
